quests.title: Returns at Ingleburn
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. I am sending back 81 papers a day from Ingleburn and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. It started small, the way these things do. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Ingleburn
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. They will drop my Ingleburn order if I can show $81 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the first of the month. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: $81, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Ingleburn Round
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I do the Ingleburn round from five in the morning and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Ingleburn
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. There is a dog on the Ingleburn round that has had two of my bags and a chest freezer that hums in D that was not even mine. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Ingleburn
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Nine of us at Ingleburn have gone in on the same numbers since the first of the month and one of us has stopped putting money in. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$81, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Ingleburn
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The agency at Macquarie Fields closed six months before Ingleburn started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Petersham
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. There has been a car in the Petersham yard since a Tuesday with a clipboard nobody signs on the passenger seat and no owner answering. It started small, the way these things do. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Petersham
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Now that it is documented, Petersham is owed $81 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: $81, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Petersham
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I am in my first year at Petersham and I have to log 84 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Petersham
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Somebody has been coming into the Petersham yard after twenty past four to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Petersham
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. My car has been at Petersham since a Tuesday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $84. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Petersham
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Petersham works out of Lewisham West, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Mulgrave
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. People leave things at the Mulgrave roller door after five in the morning and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. It started small, the way these things do. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Mulgrave
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. The photos worked, which means Mulgrave can claim back the $83 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since the first of the month. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: $83, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Mulgrave
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Something came into Mulgrave on the first of the month in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Mulgrave
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Two people have been coming into the Mulgrave sorting room since the first of the month and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$41, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Mulgrave
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. I do the Mulgrave pick-ups in a van with 41 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: come out to Windsor with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Mulgrave
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Everything Mulgrave cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Vineyard, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
